$comment: The only place a hostname is written. `base_domain` records the name the club has CHOSEN and that ISOC-IL confirmed unregistered on 2026-08-25 — it does NOT mean the domain is bought or that DNS points anywhere. The `environments` hosts below are still the Railway-generated ones and must stay that way until the CNAMEs resolve, because app/core/cors.py builds the credentialed-request allowlist from them and pointing it at a host that does not exist would break every app. HB-domain in docs/plan/state.yaml stays open until the swap is done and verified. When it is, replace the hosts here and nothing else in the repo changes — every manifest start_url and scope is relative, so no rebuild is needed either.
